title: 第2099章 他能顶得住吗第2098章 你可以试试我们谁更快
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
冷寂猛然回头，就看到苏灿带着人从地道的另一头赶了过来，后面的狄子扬不知何时小腿上中了一针滚下了台阶。
正好落在了苏灿的面前，旁边付家帮的人一把匕首架到了狄子扬的脖子上！
挑衅地看着冷寂讥笑。
冷寂的脸色黄了白，白了黑，他紧紧扣着女人的脖子，勒的她有些喘不过气来。
“冷寂，屠强已经被抓了。
你觉得自己能撑到什么时候？”
被摁在地上的狄子扬心灰意冷地道：“冷哥……你还是放下枪吧……”
就这阵势，他们怎么可能再翻盘？
眼前这个女人可是苏灿，连他们老大吕文昌都不是对手的人。
何况他们现在被人家两头堵上了，想离开这里门儿都没有。
冷寂死死勒着女人的脖子，枪口用力顶在她的下颌上，他是不甘心束手就擒的。
苏灿冷声道：“我给你三秒的考虑时间，过了这三秒，你只有死路一条了！”
这种人心狠手辣，她不会手下留情的！
“三！
二！”
苏灿的话还没喊出口，冷寂怀里的女人先昏了过去。
她在冷寂的怀里往下一个出溜，冷寂身上原本就有伤，此时又是前后夹击，女人直接滑了下去。
“好！”
冷寂直接举起了手里的枪！
萧洛身后的人立即上前钳制住了他，给他的双手戴上了手铐。

此时的冷寂才意识到，这些人当中并不仅仅是付家帮的人，而且还有港城警察局的警察！
苏灿很快带着人从地道里出来，冷寂冷冷看着她，挑衅地笑了笑：“苏灿，你不会以为自己真的赢了吧？”
苏灿淡淡一笑：“怎么？你觉得港城还会有人来救你？”
“救不救我不知道，但是我们老大不会放过你的！”
苏灿上前一步，看着他冷声道：“表面上说吕文昌不会放过我，实际上你是盼着他来救你吧？真是可惜了，到了这种时候你还觉得自己是他身边的心腹。
像你们三个这样的人，吕文昌身边有的是！
你们对他来说，就是块随时可弃的破抹布而已！”
“你放屁！”
后面的狄子扬破口大骂：“我们老大肯定会来救我们的！
你等着吧，他很快就会杀过来，你苏灿早晚会死在他的手上！”
苏灿挑眉：“杀过来？从哪儿杀？是从鹏城还是从港城？”
两人同时不屑地冷哼一声。
苏灿哦了一声：“还是说从……台岛？”
两人的脸色同时一变，狄子扬接着反驳：“我们老大才不去那种地方呢，他现在就在你们的老巢！
苏灿，你等着吧，等你这次回去，你的老巢就不保了！”
萧洛直接听笑了：“你们两个倒是挺会转移话题，真以为我们苏队长看不出来？就你俩这点心思，根本不够她看的！
告诉你们吧，我们的人已经去了台岛了。
你们不是要等着他来救你们吗？估计用不了多久，你们等来的就是他被带回内地的消息！
不过到时候你们就可以团聚了。”
这番话听的冷寂和狄子扬脸色难看不已。
content_en:
Leng Ji suddenly turned around and saw Su Can and people rushing over from the other end of the tunnel. Di Ziyang behind him got a needle in his calf and rolled down the steps.
Just in front of Su Can, someone from the Fu family gang put a dagger on Di Ziyang's neck!
He looked at Leng Ji provocatively and sneered.
Leng Ji's face turned yellow and white, then turned black. He held the woman's neck tightly, strangling her so hard that she couldn't breathe.
“Leng Ji, Tu Qiang has been arrested.
How long do you think you can last? "
Di Ziyang, who was pinned to the ground, said in frustration: "Brother Leng... you'd better put down the gun..."
With this formation, how could they possibly make a comeback again?
The woman in front of her is Su Can, someone who is not even a match for their boss, Lu Wenchang.
What's more, they are now blocked from both ends and have no way to leave.
Leng Ji strangled the woman's neck tightly, and pressed the muzzle of the gun hard against her chin. He was not willing to let her go.
Su Can said coldly: "I will give you three seconds to think about it. After these three seconds, you will only die!"
This kind of person is cruel and ruthless, she will not show mercy!
"Three!
Two! "
Before Su Can could say anything, the woman in Leng Ji's arms fainted first.
She slipped out of Leng Ji's arms. Leng Ji's body was already injured, but now they were attacked from both sides, and the woman slipped directly.
"Okay!"
Leng Ji directly raised the gun in his hand!
The people behind Xiao Luo immediately stepped forward to restrain him and put handcuffs on his hands.
Only then did Leng Ji realize that among these people were not only members of the Fujia Gang, but also police from the Hong Kong City Police Department!
Su Can quickly led people out of the tunnel. Leng Ji looked at her coldly and smiled provocatively: "Su Can, you don't think you really won, do you?"
Su Can smiled faintly: "What? Do you think there will be someone in Hong Kong City who will come to rescue you?"
"I don't know if I can save you or not, but our boss won't let you go!"
Su Can took a step forward, looked at him and said coldly: "On the surface, Lu Wenchang will not let me go, but in fact you are hoping that he will save you, right? What a pity. At this time, you still feel that you are his confidant.
There are plenty of people like you three around Lu Wenchang!
To him, you are just a rag that can be discarded at any time! "
"You fart!"
Di Ziyang from behind yelled: "Our boss will definitely come to save us!
Just wait, he will come and kill you soon, and you, Su Can, will die in his hands sooner or later! "
Su Can raised his eyebrows: "Come here to kill? Where to kill? From Peng City or from Gang City?"
The two of them snorted disdainfully at the same time.
Su Can snorted: "Or from... Taiwan Island?"
The expressions of both of them changed at the same time, and Di Ziyang retorted: "Our boss doesn't go to that kind of place, he is in your lair now!
Su Can, just wait. When you go back this time, your old nest will not be safe! "
Xiao Luo laughed directly: "You two are quite good at changing the subject. Do you really think our Captain Su can't see it? The thoughts you two have are not enough for her to notice!
Let me tell you, our people have already gone to Taiwan.
Aren't you going to wait for him to save you? It won't be long before the news you are waiting for is the news that he has been brought back to the mainland!
But then you can reunite. "
Hearing these words, Leng Ji and Di Ziyang looked ugly.
